# Renewal tracker

Version 0.1 · Prepared 2026-10-13 · Proposed operating practice pending owner adoption

Use `templates/renewals.csv` in private storage for vendors, domains, insurance and client contracts. One row per obligation, with owner and a backup.

Required: item ID/type/provider/client reference, currency/current cost, billing cadence, auto-renewal status, term end/renewal date, notice lead days, exact notice deadline with timezone, proposed review date, payer, terms link, export/exit time, decision, confirmation evidence and next action.

Work backward from the cancellation/notice deadline, not only the charge date. Proposed internal review cadence: 90 days for major contracts/insurance, 60 days for renewals requiring migration, 30 days for ordinary subscriptions; shorten only when actual terms permit. Verify dates from the current contract. A reminder does not cancel a service.

Monthly compare tracker against statements, cloud subscriptions, domain registrars and executed contracts. Identify unused seats, duplicate tools, expired cards, missed notices and coverage gaps. Any renewal, cancellation with fees or changed recurring cost follows the owner's transaction-specific approval process. Automations are documented only until separately authorized.
